question:
**Parts of the given sentence have been given as options. One of them contains a spelling error. Select the option that contains the error.**

In research done by an online publecation it was found that most popular password is 123456!
solution:
The correct answer is **'publication'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence the word '**publecation**' is wrongly spelled. 
 
• The right spelling is **'publication' **which means **a book or journal issued for public sale**. (प्रकाशन)
 
 
• Example- The Penguin **Publication** is a trusted company for book lovers.
 
 
 
• Hence, this is the most appropriate option.

**Correct Sentence:**__ *In research done by an online __**publication**__ it was found that most popular password is 123456!*
